title: Compliance Questions and Answers: Appraisal Rush Fees in a Mortgage Loan File Zero-Tolerance Cure
content:
**The rule.** For the zero-tolerance cure on a Mortgage Loan File, where the borrower requested rush turn time on the file's live primary appraisal order and a rush fee charge is booked on it, the booked rush fee is taken out of the measured increase because the borrower asked for it; where the borrower requested rush turn time and no rush fee charge is booked, the report type's rush fee is taken out; where rush turn time was not requested, or the file has no live primary appraisal order, nothing is taken out.

The facts are those of the file's live primary Appraisal Order — the order placed on the file as a standard order, a transferred-in order or a new order after expiration that is not cancelled; a file carries at most one such order: whether the borrower asked for rush turn time when the order was placed, the rush fee charges among its appraisal charges, and the rush fee of the order's report type in the Appraisal Order report-type schedule.

**Q. Why is a rush fee taken out of the measured increase?** Because the borrower asked for it.

**Q. Rush turn time was requested and a rush fee of 150.00 USD is booked on the order. How much is taken out?** 150.00 USD, the booked rush fee.

**Q. Rush turn time was requested, but no rush fee charge is on the order. How much is taken out?** The rush fee of the order's report type.

**Q. The order shows no request for rush turn time. How much is taken out?** Nothing.

| Rush requested | Rush fee charge booked | Taken out |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the booked rush fee |
| yes | no | the report type's rush fee |
| no | either | nothing |
| no live primary appraisal order on the file | — | nothing |
